I have a small stall outside the railway station. One day, some college students came. They were talking in English and ignoring me. One boy said, 'One tea without sugar?' I didn't understand. I gave him normal tea. Everyone started laughing. They said, 'Don't you understand English?' That day, it hurt a lot. My name is Babulal. I sell tea. But that day I felt that people give less respect if you don't know English. At night, my son said, 'Papa, you can also learn.' I laughed. 'English from us?' But he downloaded the SpeakEasy app. Every day after closing the stall, I used to practice. I spoke English with AI teacher Vani. Download the SpeakEasy app.] Speaker B: अभी SpeakEasy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
